name: proxmox-ve
label: Proxmox VE Hypervisor
description: Proxmox VE connector, Enables VM and container provisioning, configuration and deletion via the Proxmox REST API using token-based authentication.

fields.name: host
fields.title: Hostname / IP
fields.tooltip: IP address or hostname of the Proxmox VE server
fields.description: Hostname or IP address of the Proxmox VE server.

fields.name: token_id
fields.title: Token ID
fields.tooltip: Token ID in the format user@authentication_method!TokenID (as displayed on Proxmox WebUI)
fields.description: Token ID in the format user@authentication_method!TokenID (as displayed on Proxmox WebUI)

fields.name: node
fields.title: Default Node Name
fields.tooltip: Default node name (for example pve). Used when no node parameter is provided in the playbook.
fields.description: Default node name (for example pve). Used when no node parameter is provided in the playbook.

fields.name: verify_ssl
fields.title: Verify SSL
fields.description: Verify the server SSL certificate (default: false for testing).
fields.tooltip: Verify the server SSL certificate (default: false for testing).

operations.title: Resize VM Disk
operations.description: Resizes a QEMU disk (qm resize). Use target_gb to grow to the requested size, or size for explicit +10G / 32G.

parameters.name: node
parameters.title: Node
parameters.tooltip: Proxmox node name (optional, uses connector default if empty)
parameters.description: Proxmox node name (optional, uses connector default if empty)

parameters.description: VMID of the VM

parameters.name: disk
parameters.title: Disk
parameters.description: Disk id (default scsi0)

parameters.name: target_gb
parameters.title: Target size (GB)
parameters.description: Grow boot disk to this size in GB (skips if already larger)

parameters.name: assume_current_gb
parameters.title: Assume current size (GB)
parameters.description: Fallback when qm config has no readable size (e.g. template default 10)

parameters.name: size
parameters.title: Size
parameters.description: Explicit resize, e.g. +10G or 32G (used when target_gb is omitted)

parameters.name: timeout
parameters.title: Resize wait timeout (seconds)
parameters.description: Max seconds to wait for resize task (default 600)
